infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: This app uses the camera to take photos of civic issues for reporting.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: This app uses the microphone to record voice descriptions of civic issues.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: This app uses your location to identify and report civic issues in your area.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: This app uses your location to identify and report civic issues in your area.

plugins.photosPermission: The app needs access to your photos to let you add images to your civic issue reports.

plugins.microphonePermission: Allow $(PRODUCT_NAME) to access your microphone to record voice descriptions of civic issues.

plugins.locationPermission: Allow $(PRODUCT_NAME) to use your location to identify and report civic issues in your area.
